comparator.name: Filosofie
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme page and 2026–2027 curriculum establish a three-year, 180-ECTS Dutch-language bachelor. Years 1 and 2 each provide 60 ECTS of compulsory Philosophy and academic-skills courses. Year 3 contains a genuine 30-ECTS free-choice semester (exchange, Philosophy electives, an internal minor, or a minor at another Dutch university) and a 30-ECTS track. The generic registry target does not select a track. Filosofie Algemeen is fixed by the broad-academic-identity rule because it continues the programme’s four cross-cutting Philosophy pillars and research orientation, whereas Ondernemen is the more domain-specific practice-and-internship route. The choice was made independently of UCR fit. All 180 ECTS are accounted for without filling the genuine free-choice space.

alternatives.labelRationale: The completed route combines Ethics and Political Philosophy with law, institutions, social theory and environmental justice, making normative public questions its clearest organising focus.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Compared with the closest match, this route replaces ten courses in archaeology, literary interpretation, intercultural history and general rhetoric with Law, Society & Justice, comparative politics, criminal and constitutional law, EU law, modern and contemporary sociology, environmental justice, gender history and an advanced history research seminar. The result prioritises normative public questions and institutions rather than a broad historical-philosophical survey.

alternatives.labelRationale: The completed route links Philosophy of Mind and questions of the self with cognitive science, psycholinguistics, psychology and AI, so mind, language and intelligent systems provide the most specific truthful label.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Compared with the closest match, this route replaces twelve courses in political philosophy, law, history, archaeology, world literature and international politics with brain and behaviour, neurobiology, perception and action, psycholinguistics, social and experimental psychology, higher cognition, programming, machine learning, AI ethics and an advanced psychology research seminar. It therefore changes both the disciplinary mix and the central questions from broad philosophical history to mind, meaning and intelligent systems.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest match covers Tilburg’s broad four-pillar Philosophy identity and the selected Filosofie Algemeen route. The programme’s political-social and mind-language strands each support a coherent, materially distinct UCR curriculum and are included as alternatives 2 and 3. The formal Ondernemen track is independently coherent, but the production contract permits at most three UCR alternatives; it is therefore recorded as maximum-reached.

notes.text: Tilburg supplies a continuous 150-ECTS Philosophy curriculum plus a 30-ECTS free-choice semester, including compulsory history of philosophy, epistemology, metaphysics, philosophical methodology and language, the Filosofie Algemeen track, and a required 10-ECTS thesis. UCR offers five dedicated Philosophy courses and constructs related routes with Politics, Law, Communication, History, Literature, Sociology, Cognitive Science, Psychology and AI. These interdisciplinary pathways do not reproduce Tilburg’s sustained specialist depth, full two-year compulsory sequence, dedicated third-year Philosophy track, or required Philosophy thesis.
